title: Kioxia and Dell cram 10 PB into slim 2RU server
summary: Kioxia and Dell collaborated to develop an ultra-high-density storage server capable of storing 10 petabytes of data within just 2 rack units, representing a major breakthrough in storage density for enterprise data centers.
problem_solved: Addresses the critical space and cost constraints in data centers by achieving unprecedented storage density—5 PB per rack unit—in a compact form factor.
why_valuable: Enables enterprises to dramatically reduce their data center footprint and operational costs while scaling storage capacity, which is essential as global data volumes continue exponential growth.
